hypothesis: One live local Chromium/X11 task can use a fresh intermediate window observation after Save to select Confirm, complete one exact fixture submission, and refuse when the required intermediate state is not present.

test.negative_control: Confirm admission is refused unless the active X11 window is the same fixture window and its current title is exactly CONFIRMING.

stop_rule: One run only. Stop on first launch, observation, admission, execution, effect, timeout, or audit failure. No rerun. Success requires exactly one matching server-side submission, runtime TASK_SUCCEEDED after two transitions, two fresh admissions, two successful independent stage checks, and verified terminal mouse release on both clicks.
scope_limit: One synthetic Chromium fixture and title-based X11 observation. No provider/model, user data, matched baseline, multi-task reuse, measured economics, or #3311 six-task acceptance claim. Does not consume or replace issue #4710 formal-01.
